Name: EarlyWakeUp
Author: ismael1508
Description:
[b]☀️ Early Wake Up ☀️
[/b]
Tired of wasting those precious early morning hours? Early Wake Up gives you the head start you need by allowing you to customize exactly when your farmer wakes up every morning!

[b]✨ Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Early Starts: Wake up as early as 4:00 AM to get a head start on your crops or fishing.
[*]Customizable: You decide your schedule. Set any time between 4:00 AM and 12:50 PM.
[*]Lightweight: Built for SMAPI 3.18.0+ to ensure maximum compatibility and performance.
[/list][b]🛠️ How to Install[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI: Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed.

[*]Download: Download this mod and extract the [b]EarlyWakeUp[/b] folder.

[*]Place in Mods: Move the folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods directory[/b].

[*]Launch: Run the game once using the SMAPI shortcut to generate the configuration file.

[/list][b]⚙️ How to ConfigureYou can personalize your wake-up time easily:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Mods/EarlyWakeUp.

[*]Open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editor (like Notepad).

[*]Change the "WakeUpTime" value to your preferred time (using the game's internal format, e.g., 400 for 4:00 AM).

[*]Save the file and restart your game!
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Settings Menu: Now you can configure your wake-up time directly inside the game! No more editing files manually.
"Random Wake Up" Mode: Feeling adventurous? Enable this option to wake up at a random time each morning (between 4:00 AM and 10:00 AM).
